t: 瑞典海军夺取了俄罗斯波罗的海舰队的三分之一.
te: The Swedish Navy captures one third of the Russian Baltic fleet.
dz: 瑞典海军夺取了俄罗斯波罗的海舰队的三分之一.
de: The Swedish Navy captures one third of the Russian Baltic fleet.

t: 在凡尔赛，国民议会重组为国民制宪议会，并开始为法国宪法做准备。
te: In Versailles, the National Assembly reconstitutes itself as the National Constituent Assembly and begins preparations …
dz: 在凡尔赛，国民议会重组为国民制宪议会，并开始为法国宪法做准备。
de: In Versailles, the National Assembly reconstitutes itself as the National Constituent Assembly and begins preparations for a French constitution.

t: 乔治·华盛顿下令向曼哈顿的大陆军成员宣读《独立宣言》，而斯塔顿岛上的数千名英国士兵正在为长岛战…
te: George Washington orders the Declaration of Independence to be read out to members of the Continental Army in Manhattan…
dz: 乔治·华盛顿下令向曼哈顿的大陆军成员宣读《独立宣言》，而斯塔顿岛上的数千名英国士兵正在为长岛战役做准备。
de: George Washington orders the Declaration of Independence to be read out to members of the Continental Army in Manhattan, while thousands of British troops on Staten Island prepare for the Battle of Long Island.

t: 莫扎特家族欧洲大巡演开始,提升了儿子沃尔夫冈·阿马德乌斯的形象.
te: The Mozart family grand tour of Europe begins, lifting the profile of son Wolfgang Amadeus.
dz: 莫扎特家族欧洲大巡演开始,提升了儿子沃尔夫冈·阿马德乌斯的形象.
de: The Mozart family grand tour of Europe begins, lifting the profile of son Wolfgang Amadeus.

t: 凯瑟琳大帝在反对她丈夫彼得三世的政变后成为了俄罗斯皇后.
te: Catherine the Great becomes Empress of Russia following the coup against her husband, Peter III.
dz: 凯瑟琳大帝在反对她丈夫彼得三世的政变后成为了俄罗斯皇后.
de: Catherine the Great becomes Empress of Russia following the coup against her husband, Peter III.

t: 布洛克远征军在试图攻克现在匹兹堡市中心的杜克内堡时,被一支规模较小的法国和美洲原住民部队在声音…
te: The Braddock Expedition is soundly defeated by a smaller French and Native American force in its attempt to capture For…
dz: 布洛克远征军在试图攻克现在匹兹堡市中心的杜克内堡时,被一支规模较小的法国和美洲原住民部队在声音上击败.
de: The Braddock Expedition is soundly defeated by a smaller French and Native American force in its attempt to capture Fort Duquesne in what is now downtown Pittsburgh.

t: 法国在梅勒战役中取得胜利,使他们得以在后几天内攻克根特.
te: French victory in the Battle of Melle allows them to capture Ghent in the days after.
dz: 法国在梅勒战役中取得胜利,使他们得以在后几天内攻克根特.
de: French victory in the Battle of Melle allows them to capture Ghent in the days after.

t: 萨法维德伊朗在叶格耶夫尔德之战中击败了他们后从奥斯曼帝国手中夺取了甘贾.
te: Safavid Iran captures Ganja from the Ottoman Empire after defeating them in the battle of Yeghevārd.
dz: 萨法维德伊朗在叶格耶夫尔德之战中击败了他们后从奥斯曼帝国手中夺取了甘贾.
de: Safavid Iran captures Ganja from the Ottoman Empire after defeating them in the battle of Yeghevārd.

t: 在卡皮战役中由尼古拉斯·卡蒂纳特(英语:Nicolas Catinat)手下的一支波旁部队从萨…
te: A Bourbon force under Nicolas Catinat withdraws from a smaller Habsburg force under Prince Eugene of Savoy in the Battl…
dz: 在卡皮战役中由尼古拉斯·卡蒂纳特(英语:Nicolas Catinat)手下的一支波旁部队从萨伏伊亲王尤金(英语:Eugene of Savoy)手下规模较小的哈布斯堡部队中撤退.
de: A Bourbon force under Nicolas Catinat withdraws from a smaller Habsburg force under Prince Eugene of Savoy in the Battle of Carpi.

t: 波希米亚通过神圣罗马皇帝鲁道夫二世的陛下信授予宗教自由.
te: Bohemia is granted freedom of religion through the Letter of Majesty by the Holy Roman Emperor, Rudolf II.
dz: 波希米亚通过神圣罗马皇帝鲁道夫二世的陛下信授予宗教自由.
de: Bohemia is granted freedom of religion through the Letter of Majesty by the Holy Roman Emperor, Rudolf II.

t: 19名天主教徒因信仰而殉道,在荷兰城镇戈尔库姆.
te: Nineteen Catholics suffer martyrdom for their beliefs, in the Dutch town of Gorkum.
dz: 19名天主教徒因信仰而殉道,在荷兰城镇戈尔库姆.
de: Nineteen Catholics suffer martyrdom for their beliefs, in the Dutch town of Gorkum.

t: 英国国王亨利八世废除了与第四任妻子克利夫斯的安妮的婚姻。
te: King Henry VIII of England annuls his marriage to his fourth wife, Anne of Cleves.
dz: 英国国王亨利八世废除了与第四任妻子克利夫斯的安妮的婚姻。
de: King Henry VIII of England annuls his marriage to his fourth wife, Anne of Cleves.

t: 帖木儿攻击贾莱里苏丹国并摧毁巴格达。
te: Timur attacks the Jalairid Sultanate and destroys Baghdad.
dz: 帖木儿攻击贾莱里苏丹国并摧毁巴格达。
de: Timur attacks the Jalairid Sultanate and destroys Baghdad.

t: 旧瑞士邦联通过在塞姆帕赫战役中稳妥地击败奥地利公国,在建立对其领土的控制上取得了长足的进步.
te: The Old Swiss Confederacy makes great strides in establishing control over its territory by soundly defeating the Duchy…
dz: 旧瑞士邦联通过在塞姆帕赫战役中稳妥地击败奥地利公国,在建立对其领土的控制上取得了长足的进步.
de: The Old Swiss Confederacy makes great strides in establishing control over its territory by soundly defeating the Duchy of Austria in the Battle of Sempach.

t: 皇帝查理四世协助为布拉格的查尔斯桥奠基.
te: Emperor Charles IV assists in laying the foundation stone of Charles Bridge in Prague.
dz: 皇帝查理四世协助为布拉格的查尔斯桥奠基.
de: Emperor Charles IV assists in laying the foundation stone of Charles Bridge in Prague.

t: 法蒂米德将军乔哈尔以卡利夫·穆伊兹·利-丁·阿拉为名领导了富斯塔特的星期五祈祷会,从而象征性地…
te: The Fatimid general Jawhar leads the Friday prayer in Fustat in the name of Caliph al-Mu'izz li-Din Allah, thereby symb…
dz: 法蒂米德将军乔哈尔以卡利夫·穆伊兹·利-丁·阿拉为名领导了富斯塔特的星期五祈祷会,从而象征性地完成了法蒂米德对埃及的征服.
de: The Fatimid general Jawhar leads the Friday prayer in Fustat in the name of Caliph al-Mu'izz li-Din Allah, thereby symbolically completing the Fatimid conquest of Egypt.

t: 日本本州北部仙台周边地区发生了 8.4–9.0 Mw 三陆地震。海啸造成的洪水向内陆延伸了几公…
te: The 8.4–9.0 Mw Sanriku earthquake strikes the area around Sendai in northern Honshu, Japan. Inundation from the tsunami…
dz: 日本本州北部仙台周边地区发生了 8.4–9.0 Mw 三陆地震。海啸造成的洪水向内陆延伸了几公里。
de: The 8.4–9.0 Mw Sanriku earthquake strikes the area around Sendai in northern Honshu, Japan. Inundation from the tsunami extended several kilometers inland.

t: 金玉信将军所领导的西拉部队在黄山北道会战中击败了白起的军队.
te: Silla forces under general Kim Yu-sin defeat the army of Baekje at the Battle of Hwangsanbeol.
dz: 金玉信将军所领导的西拉部队在黄山北道会战中击败了白起的军队.
de: Silla forces under general Kim Yu-sin defeat the army of Baekje at the Battle of Hwangsanbeol.

t: 一场大地震袭击了贝鲁特,引发了一场破坏性的海啸,波及了沿海城镇拜占庭腓尼基亚,造成上千人死亡.
te: A major earthquake strikes Beirut, triggering a devastating tsunami that affects the coastal towns of Byzantine Phoenic…
dz: 一场大地震袭击了贝鲁特,引发了一场破坏性的海啸,波及了沿海城镇拜占庭腓尼基亚,造成上千人死亡.
de: A major earthquake strikes Beirut, triggering a devastating tsunami that affects the coastal towns of Byzantine Phoenicia, causing thousands of deaths.

t: Odoacer与他的赫鲁利守卫进行夜间攻击,在阿德皮内坦与Theoderic the Grea…
te: Odoacer makes a night assault with his Heruli guardsmen, engaging Theoderic the Great in Ad Pinetam. Both sides suffer …
dz: Odoacer与他的赫鲁利守卫进行夜间攻击,在阿德皮内坦与Theoderic the Great会合. 双方都遭受了沉重的损失,但最终西奥多克力将奥多亚塞尔带回了拉文纳.
de: Odoacer makes a night assault with his Heruli guardsmen, engaging Theoderic the Great in Ad Pinetam. Both sides suffer heavy losses, but in the end Theodoric forces Odoacer back into Ravenna.

t: 年长的贵族阿维图斯被哥特式国王特奥德里克二世在图卢兹所封为罗马皇帝.
te: The elderly noble Avitus is proclaimed Roman emperor by Gothic king Theoderic II in Toulouse.
dz: 年长的贵族阿维图斯被哥特式国王特奥德里克二世在图卢兹所封为罗马皇帝.
de: The elderly noble Avitus is proclaimed Roman emperor by Gothic king Theoderic II in Toulouse.

t: 由罗马皇帝特奥多修斯一世在君士坦丁堡召集的基督教主教第一届理事会的结束.
te: The end of the First Council of Christian bishops convened in Constantinople by the Roman emperor Theodosius I.
dz: 由罗马皇帝特奥多修斯一世在君士坦丁堡召集的基督教主教第一届理事会的结束.
de: The end of the First Council of Christian bishops convened in Constantinople by the Roman emperor Theodosius I.

t: 哈德良在特拉扬去世一年前成为了皇帝,他让自己进入了罗马.
te: Hadrian, who became emperor a year previously on Trajan's death, makes his entry into Rome.
dz: 哈德良在特拉扬去世一年前成为了皇帝,他让自己进入了罗马.
de: Hadrian, who became emperor a year previously on Trajan's death, makes his entry into Rome.
